notes: The G2X mirror for NIH solicitation 75N98026Q00260 is only a notice of intent, posted 27 Apr 2026 and due 7 May 2026. It covers NovaSeq X Series 25B Reagent Kits (NAICS 325414, PSC 6550, Bethesda MD, contact David Shen, no set-aside). The G2X page now redirects to g2x.com, which returned 403 when I fetched it. Search snippets show no quantity, award value, awardee or protest. A USAspending search for the solicitation number returned an empty shell page with no award data. An award notice under this number may exist on SAM.gov or USAspending, but I could not reach it. I could not compute an implied $/kit or discount. A separate Navy notice (solicitation 1301397256, posted 23 Jul 2026) is a sole-source intent to buy Illumina reagent kits, with no quantity or price in the snippet. It is not the NIH notice and is unverified.
how_to_mine: Query the USAspending API (POST api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/search/spending_by_award/) with keyword '75N98026Q00260', or search by the award PIID, and read the obligated amount. The kit quantity would be in the award description or in the SAM.gov notice PDF. Divide the obligation by the kit count to get $/kit and compare it with $24,155 (GSA 25B-300), or with ~$16K if that is the right list price. Also check FPDS ezSearch for PIID 75N98026P*. A brute-force check of the samsearch.co and govcontractfinder.com mirrors for the Navy notice 1301397256 is possible but low value.
new_candidates: USAspending API keyword search for the NIH award PIID tied to 75N98026Q00260 (obligation amount and description)
FPDS ezSearch for Illumina awards under NIH 75N980 in FY26, to get realized kit prices
